statements.statement: The member presented with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The member has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The member has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms were intermittent and needed to be correlated with the patient's hemodynamic status
The provider ordered CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring)
The service was to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before the service was rendered
